segments.en: So we're going to find out what the words mean in this very classic song.

segments.zh: 好的，24 日晚上，玛丽和约瑟夫正在寻找一个住宿的地方。

segments.zh: 玛丽，上帝的处女之母，将生下一个婴儿。

segments.en: And they need a place to stay so finally they find a place.
segments.zh: 他们需要一个地方住，所以他们最终找到了一个地方。

segments.zh: 这不是酒店，也不是房子。

segments.en: Yeah, well it's actually the stables for the inn, right?

segments.en: Yeah, the stables for the inn, yeah.
segments.zh: 是的，旅馆的马厩，是的。

segments.en: So that's where we are.

segments.en: Alright, so the first line says silent night, holy night.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以第一行说寂静的夜晚，圣夜。

segments.en: As you know it's holy, that means it's religiously special, it's important.

segments.en: Okay, all is calm, all is bright.

segments.zh: 好吧，下一行很有趣，因为它说的是关于处女的母亲和孩子。

segments.zh: 现在你在那里看到了前两个字，圆圆的。

segments.zh: Yon 的意思是那边。

segments.en: So around over there, so over there we've got two people.
segments.zh: 所以在那边，所以在那边我们有两个人。

segments.en: And the child would be Jesus.
segments.zh: 孩子就是耶稣。

segments.en: And it says holy infant, so tender and mild.
segments.zh: 它说圣婴，如此温柔和温和。

segments.en: Okay so what is an infant?
segments.zh: 好的，那么什么是婴儿？

segments.en: An infant is a baby, some baby that's just been born.
segments.zh: 婴儿是婴儿，一些刚刚出生的婴儿。

segments.en: So we can say that infants are very, very delicate.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说婴儿非常非常精致。

segments.en: You have to be very careful when you hold an infant.
segments.zh: 当你抱着一个婴儿时，你必须非常小心。

segments.en: But in this case a holy infant is Jesus, he's special for religious reasons.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，一个圣洁的婴儿是耶稣，他出于宗教原因是特别的。

segments.en: And when they say that he's tender and mild, what does he mean by that?
segments.zh: 当他们说他温柔而温和时，他是什么意思？

segments.en: Well you talk about tender things when you're talking about things that are soft, delicate, gentle or sweet.
segments.zh: 当你说某样东西柔软、娇嫩、温柔或甜美时，就可以用tender来形容。

segments.en: And something that is mild or someone that is mild is very quiet and calm and gentle.
segments.zh: 温和的东西或温和的人是非常安静、平静和温柔的。

segments.en: So not making much noise.
segments.zh: 所以没有发出太多的噪音。

segments.en: So the baby is very sweet, very tender and wasn't crying or making a big fuss.
segments.zh: 所以宝宝很可爱，很嫩，没有哭，也没有大惊小怪。

segments.en: And then we have sleep in heavenly peace, sleep in heavenly peace.
segments.zh: 然后我们在天上的平安中睡觉，在天上的平安中睡觉。

segments.en: Well the baby's quiet because the baby's sleeping.
segments.zh: 好吧，因为宝宝在睡觉，所以宝宝很安静。

segments.en: So you're saying sleep in heavenly peace, that means may the peace of heaven, because heaven is a very peaceful place, the most peaceful place, may that peace be with you when you're sleeping.
segments.zh: 所以，“在天堂般的安宁中入睡”，意思是愿天堂的平安伴你入眠，因为天堂是非常宁静、最为安宁的地方。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And moving on we have silent night, holy night again.
segments.zh: 继续前进，我们又有了寂静的夜晚，又是圣夜。

segments.en: But then they say shepherds quake at the sight.
segments.zh: 但随后他们说牧羊人看到了地震。

segments.en: So what is this?
segments.zh: 那么这是什么？

segments.en: Shepherds we know that these are people that take care of sheep.
segments.zh: 牧羊人 我们知道这些人是照顾羊的人。

segments.en: That's right, they make the sheep move from one place to another.
segments.zh: 没错，他们让羊从一个地方移动到另一个地方。

segments.en: And it says they quake at the sight.
segments.zh: 它说他们一看到就地震。

segments.en: So they quake at the sight of what?
segments.zh: 所以他们一看到什么就震惊了？

segments.en: Well quake, we often say quiver in one's boots.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们经常说穿着靴子的颤抖。

segments.en: So to quake means to shake when you're nervous.
segments.zh: 所以到地震意味着当你紧张时摇晃。

segments.en: So you know when you're going to make a speech in front of many, many, many people, your hands start to shake, that's called quaking.
segments.zh: 比如你要在很多很多人面前演讲时，双手开始发抖，这就叫quaking。

segments.en: So to quake.
segments.zh: 所以到地震。

segments.en: So shepherds quake, they're nervous at the sight, well the sight is the noun for seeing something.
segments.zh: 所以“牧羊人颤抖”，是说他们看到这一景象时紧张得发抖。sight是表示所见景象的名词。

segments.en: The sight of Jesus.
segments.zh: 耶稣的视线。

segments.en: Of the baby.
segments.zh: 的婴儿。

segments.en: Okay, okay, okay, okay.
segments.zh: 好吧，好吧，好吧。

segments.en: Glories stream from heaven afar.
segments.zh: 荣耀从天上流出。

segments.en: So glories stream from heaven afar.
segments.zh: 于是，荣耀从天上流出。

segments.en: Okay, the verb here, the action word is to stream.
segments.zh: 好的，这里的动词，动作词是流。

segments.en: To stream.
segments.zh: 流。

segments.en: Okay, that means to come down.
segments.zh: 好吧，这意味着要下来。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Okay, so to come down in kind of big amounts.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以要大幅下降。

segments.en: So we have glory, glory, so happiness and joy and glory and good things coming down from the heavens.
segments.zh: 这里说的是荣光、荣耀，也就是幸福、喜悦和各种美好的事物从天上降临。

segments.en: So lots of positive, good things coming down from heaven.
segments.zh: 这么多积极的，从天上降下来的好东西。

segments.en: And where is heaven?
segments.zh: 天堂在哪里？

segments.en: Afar.
segments.zh: 远处。

segments.en: Afar.
segments.zh: 远处。

segments.en: So the key part of this is the word far.
segments.zh: 所以这个词的关键部分是远方。

segments.en: It's far away, right?
segments.zh: 很远，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Afar is an old word we use to describe something that's far away.
segments.zh: Afar 是一个古老的词，我们用来形容遥远的事物。

segments.en: So the heavens afar, the heavens that are far away are giving us all of this joy and happiness.
segments.zh: 所以远处的天堂，远方的天堂给了我们所有这些快乐和幸福。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And then the song says heavenly hosts sing hallelujah.
segments.zh: 然后这首歌说天堂主人唱哈利路亚。

segments.en: So heavenly hosts, those are bodies or people or spirits in the sky.
segments.zh: 所以天上的主人，那些是天空中的身体、人或灵魂。

segments.en: Like angels.
segments.zh: 像天使一样。

segments.en: Angels.
segments.zh: 天使。

segments.en: They're singing hallelujah.
segments.zh: 他们在唱哈利路亚。

segments.en: So hallelujah is a word that we often use in the Christian religion that comes from Greek actually.
segments.zh: 哈利路亚是基督教中常用的一个词，实际上它来自希腊语。

segments.en: Oh really?
segments.zh: 哦，真的吗？

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So hallelujah is a Greek word and it means celebrate, joy, amen.
segments.zh: 所以哈利路亚是一个希腊词，它的意思是庆祝、欢乐、阿门。

segments.en: Okay, hallelujah.
segments.zh: 好吧，哈利路亚。

segments.en: It's something you're happy about.
segments.zh: 这是你很高兴的事情。

segments.en: Hallelujah.
segments.zh: 哈利路亚。

segments.en: Hallelujah.

segments.en: And then they say Christ, the savior is born.
segments.zh: 然后他们说基督，救主诞生了。

segments.en: Now we have this, the savior.
segments.zh: 现在我们有了这个，救世主。

segments.en: What is it?
segments.zh: 怎么了？

segments.en: Who is a savior?
segments.zh: 谁是救世主？

segments.en: What is a savior?
segments.zh: 什么是救世主？

segments.en: It's a very good question.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

segments.en: A savior is a word we only really, well, we don't hear that often, but you've heard the word to save before.
segments.zh: savior这个词其实不太常听到，不过表示“救”的save，你以前一定听过。

segments.en: So for example, I fell into the water and Marco jumped in and saved me.
segments.zh: 例如，我掉进了水里，马可跳进去救了我。

segments.en: So I would be a savior?
segments.zh: 所以我会成为救世主？

segments.en: Marco is my savior.
segments.zh: 马可是我的救星。

segments.en: He saved me.
segments.zh: 他救了我。

segments.en: But in this case, savior refers to the Bible and the things that Jesus did later.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，救主指的是圣经和耶稣后来做的事情。

segments.en: So we say in Christianity, he saved people, the humankind.
segments.zh: 所以我们在基督教中说，他拯救了人，人类。

segments.en: So he is the savior.
segments.zh: 所以他是救世主。

segments.en: Christ the savior.
segments.zh: 基督救世主。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And then our next verse, it says, silent night, holy night, son of God loves pure light, radiant beams from thy holy face.
segments.zh: 接下来一节唱的是：“平安夜，圣善夜，神之子，爱的纯洁之光，光辉从你的圣容发出。”

segments.en: So we have radiant beams and then we have this word thy.
segments.zh: 所以我们有辐射光束，然后我们有这个词你。

segments.en: So these beams is like a beam of light, right?
segments.zh: 所以这些光束就像一束光，对吧？

segments.en: It's like a line of light, but you know how light is clear.
segments.zh: 它就像一道光线，但你知道光有多清晰。

segments.en: So a beam of light is something that comes down in a straight line.
segments.zh: 所以一束光是直线下降的东西。

segments.en: You can see it.
segments.zh: 你可以看到它。

segments.en: You can see it.
segments.zh: 你可以看到它。

segments.en: So for example, when I turn on a flashlight and there's a line of light, that's a beam.
segments.zh: 例如，当我打开手电筒并且有一束光线时，那就是一束光束。

segments.en: And radiant means it's very bright.
segments.zh: 光芒四射意味着它非常明亮。

segments.en: It's very clear.
segments.zh: 非常清楚。

segments.en: Clear and it's strong and it's coming out from that one place.
segments.zh: 清晰，它很坚固，它从那一处出来。

segments.en: And what about this word thy?
segments.zh: 你的这个词呢？

segments.en: It's very popular, like old English, right?
segments.zh: 它很受欢迎，就像古英语一样，对吧？

segments.en: It's an old English form of saying you.
segments.zh: 这是一种古老的英语形式的你。

segments.en: So in the olden days in English, we had different ways of saying the word you.
segments.zh: 所以在过去的英语中，我们有不同的方式来表达你这个词。

segments.en: And so thy is one of those words and you hear this very often.
segments.zh: 所以你是其中之一，你经常听到这个。

segments.en: And so in this sentence, we're saying radiant beams from thy holy face.
segments.zh: 所以在这句话中，我们说的是你圣洁的脸上的光芒。

segments.en: We're now starting to talk to Jesus because we're referring to him.
segments.zh: 我们现在开始与耶稣交谈，因为我们指的是他。

segments.en: You radiant beams, light is coming out of your face.
segments.zh: 你光芒四射，光从你的脸上冒出来。

segments.en: Your holy face.
segments.zh: 你的圣面。

segments.en: Because you're such a holy.
segments.zh: 因为你是如此神圣。

segments.en: I think you can probably see this thy and thou in Shakespeare, for example, right?
segments.zh: 例如，我想你可能会在莎士比亚看到你和你，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Shakespeare, the Bible, prayers, and all sorts of old books and poetry.
segments.zh: 莎士比亚、圣经、祈祷和各种老书和诗歌。

segments.en: And then we say with the dawn of redeeming grace.
segments.zh: 然后我们带着救赎恩典的黎明说。

segments.en: So what is to redeem?
segments.zh: 那么什么是赎回呢？

segments.en: To redeem is to find value in something that didn't have value before.
segments.zh: 赎回就是在以前没有价值的东西中找到价值。

segments.en: So maybe I have a ticket for some, okay, I won a small lottery ticket, $5.
segments.zh: 所以也许我有一张票，好吧，我赢了一张小彩票，5美元。

segments.en: I go to the store to redeem my money.
segments.zh: 我去商店兑换我的钱。

segments.en: The paper is worthless, but it's worth something when I redeem it.
segments.zh: 这张纸一文不值，但当我兑换它时，它是值得的。

segments.en: So Christ the Redeemer, when he saves people, he redeems them.
segments.zh: 所以救赎主基督，当他拯救人时，他就救赎了他们。

segments.en: He gives them value again.
segments.zh: 他再次给了他们价值。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So it's a very profound song, right?
segments.zh: 所以这是一首非常深刻的歌曲，对吧？

segments.en: And it talks about, as we say, about Jesus, about angels, and it's very, very religious.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，它谈到了耶稣，关于天使，它非常非常虔诚。

segments.en: So it's a great song and it's, well, it's a very popular song.
segments.zh: 所以这是一首很棒的歌曲，而且，它是一首非常受欢迎的歌曲。

segments.en: And well, even if you don't share the religious connotation that the song has, it still is very popular in North America and many parts of the world.
segments.zh: 即使你并不认同这首歌的宗教内涵，它在北美和世界许多地方也仍然很流行。

segments.en: So why don't we have a listen to this song one last time?
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不上次听这首歌呢？

segments.en: So when I was a little girl at school, we had to sing this in German.
segments.zh: 所以当我还是个小女孩的时候，我们不得不用德语唱这个。

segments.en: So I know that there are some other countries that have the same song with different words.
segments.zh: 所以我知道还有一些其他国家的歌词不同的单词。

segments.en: So it's the same rhythm and everything, but just in German.
segments.zh: 所以它的节奏和一切都是一样的，但只是德语。

segments.en: And is it pretty much the same idea, the same words?
segments.zh: 和它的想法差不多，同样的话吗？

segments.en: Yeah, almost exactly the same, just in a translated form.
segments.zh: 是的，几乎完全一样，只是翻译形式。

segments.en: Maybe it came from German, I don't know.
segments.zh: 也许它来自德语，我不知道。

segments.en: Because it seems to be pretty old, right?
segments.zh: 因为它看起来很老，对吧？

segments.en: But it is a very common song during Christmas.
segments.zh: 但这是圣诞节期间非常常见的歌曲。

segments.en: And even many times, Christmas carolers will go around in the neighborhood and sing these songs in different places, right?
segments.zh: 而且圣诞报佳音的人也常常走遍社区，到不同的地方唱这些歌，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And it's a really beautiful song, one of my favorites.
segments.zh: 这是一首非常美丽的歌曲，是我的最爱之一。

segments.en: And I'm not a religious person, so I don't really like it for the religious perspective that it gives.
segments.zh: 我没有宗教信仰，所以并不是因为它表达的宗教观点才喜欢它。

segments.en: But I do think that it's just one of those beautiful classic songs that makes the season very warm and special.
segments.zh: 但我确实觉得，这是一首优美的经典歌曲，能让这个节日变得格外温暖、特别。

segments.en: The music is nice in this song.
segments.zh: 这首歌的音乐很好听。

segments.en: Alright, so an interesting song and I'm sure we're going to have a lot of questions and comments about it.
segments.zh: 好，这是一首很有意思的歌，我相信大家会有很多问题和评论。

segments.en: So we expect to see you guys on our website EnglishPod.com and we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 因此，我们希望在我们的网站 Englishpod.com 上见到你们，我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Happy holidays and enjoy.
segments.zh: 节日快乐，享受。

segments.en: Bye guys.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye-bye.
segments.zh: 拜拜。
